keyPoints.en: 1841: James Brooke became Rajah after helping Brunei end a rebellion.
keyPoints.bm: 1841: James Brooke menjadi Raja selepas membantu Brunei menamatkan pemberontakan.

keyPoints.en: Rajahs: James (1841), Charles (1868), Charles Vyner (1917); Crown Colony in 1946.
keyPoints.bm: Raja: James (1841), Charles (1868), Charles Vyner (1917); Tanah Jajahan Mahkota pada 1946.

keyPoints.en: From 1881 Sabah was run by the British North Borneo Company (chartered), aiming at profit.
keyPoints.bm: Mulai 1881 Sabah ditadbir oleh Syarikat Borneo Utara British (berpiagam), bermatlamat keuntungan.

keyPoints.en: Resistance: Mat Salleh (1894–1900), Antanom (Rundum, 1915) — against taxes and forced labour.
keyPoints.bm: Penentangan: Mat Salleh (1894–1900), Antanom (Rundum, 1915) — menentang cukai dan kerahan tenaga.

keyPoints.en: Labuan was ceded to Britain in 1846. Sabah became a Crown Colony in 1946.
keyPoints.bm: Labuan diserahkan kepada British pada 1846. Sabah menjadi Tanah Jajahan Mahkota pada 1946.
